reason: C1 is chosen because it proposes a concrete intervention (introduction of controlled porosity) that is specific to the HfNbTaTiZr system and physically consistent. The mechanism of phonon scattering by porosity is well-established in materials science, and the predicted outcome of reduced phonon thermal conductivity is quantified. The falsification experiment is also well-designed, measuring thermal conductivity of porous and bulk samples over a range of temperatures. While other candidates also propose plausible interventions, C1 is the most comprehensive and well-supported hypothesis.
